json_update_template.description: Standard PowerShell template for updating honeycomb JSON files
json_update_template.template: $path = 'honeycombs/{module}/{file}.json'; git pull; $json = Get-Content $path -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json; # MODIFY JSON HERE # ; New-Item -Force -ItemType File -Path $path | Out-Null; $json | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | ForEach-Object { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Resolve-Path $path).Path, $_, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)) }; git add $path; git commit -m '{module} {version}: {description}'; git push

critical_rules.no_partial_commands: Never give partial commands. One copy-paste = one complete operation.
critical_rules.one_command_only: ALWAYS provide exactly ONE complete PowerShell command. Never split into multiple parts. Use backticks (`) or semicolons (;) for multi-line commands.
critical_rules.utf8_no_bom: When writing JSON files, MUST use: [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $content, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)). Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 adds BOM  git shows no changes.
critical_rules.api_first: Before modifying any file, request its current content via GitHub API to bypass CDN cache. Raw URL has 5-10 min delay.
critical_rules.git_pull_first: Always start with "git pull" to avoid merge conflicts.

example_full_command.command: $path = 'honeycombs/boot_online/index.json'; git pull; $json = Get-Content $path -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json; $json.identity.version = 'v2.8.2'; $json.identity.updated = (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd'); $json.content | Add-Member -Name 'new_rule' -Value @{ rule = 'Always use API' } -MemberType NoteProperty; New-Item -Force -ItemType File -Path $path | Out-Null; $json | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | ForEach-Object { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Resolve-Path $path).Path, $_, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)) }; git add $path; git commit -m 'boot_online v2.8.2: new_rule added'; git push
example_full_command.description: Example: update boot_online version and add new rule

common_pitfalls: Using "python" instead of "py"  command not found on Windows
Saving JSON with BOM  git shows empty diff
Splitting command into parts  Gardener workflow broken
Using raw URL for recently updated file  CDN cache shows old version

commands.add: git add .  # or specific file: git add honeycombs/path/file.json

git_cycle.one_liner: git pull; git add .; git commit -m "msg"; git push
git_cycle.note: Always pull before push to avoid rejection.

gardener_environment.note: Gardener only copies  pastes  presses Enter. No manual editing.

meta.when_to_read: Before generating any PowerShell command for Gardener. Especially when updating honeycomb JSON files.
